system_deps: Gazebo 10.1.0 with Dart 6.7.0 (README.md:97); the C++ plugins are built by setup.py:9-32
install.notes: The upstream package requires Gazebo 10.1.0 with Dart 6.7.0 and a digital-twin SDF (README.md:97, gymfc/envs/fc_env.py:488-493); setup.py:51 also needs numpy, protobuf and psutil. The gate and the fake backend need none of this: fake.py is pure Python. Install GymFC and Gazebo only to serve the real simulator (backend sim), which was not run.
